The recipetineats source is built on Thai GREEN curry paste (Maesri), but our list buys Thai Kitchen RED curry paste (10 oz) for a dish titled 'Thai Green Curry Chicken', changing the title-defining flavor.

The platingsandpairings sauce is 1/4 cup fish sauce + 1/4 cup SWEET soy + rice vinegar; ours subs plain soy and buys no sugar at all, dropping the sauce's defining sweetness even though the catalog stocks ABC Kecap Manis (used in turkey-nasi-goreng).

3 Tbsp fish sauce is costed but the steps never add it; in the trifectanutrition source fish sauce is THE larb seasoning, incorporated into the turkey while it cooks (source step 3).
The costed '3-4 dry chiles or 1.5 Tbsp chile powder' never appears in our steps; the source toasts and grinds the chiles and mixes the powder in first during assembly.
1/2 cup chopped cilantro is costed but never used in our steps; the source mixes it structurally into the larb, not as a garnish.
1/3 cup mint is costed but never used in our steps; mint mixed into the meat is a defining larb herb in the source.
